column1: # `cost_sol` is priced from cohort-13's own ledger; `-` means it moves no
# lamports. `blocks` names what cannot start until this row is green.
# Tabs separate the fields. `check-steps.py` gates this file against README.md.

column3: solana program close, one role at a time, ids derived from cohort-13's keypair files
column4: deployer balance rises by the table total less seven 5,000-lamport fees, and each Program account still names its ProgramData at offset 4

column3: checked-release-candidate.sh --genesis-cohort at the deploy commit, then seven solana program deploy
column4: CANDIDATE_EXIT=0, sbf_build_diagnostics_total=0, a second detached worktree reproduces all seven ELFs byte-identically, and each live image is dumped back and compared BEFORE the next deploy starts

column3: campaign --through activation, campaign payer funded with 2 SOL first
column4: a second preflight that READS THE CLUSTER reports substrate, publication, initialize, succession and activation all complete; zero transaction errors

column3: prepare --general-accelerator-program-id 8pgnyNvgdue7Jc8aw75BGWoghsKGevWJvFom8omUWvQY ...
column4: the plan carries general_accelerator and a general_accelerator_artifact_release record; the Registry FINALIZES it, which is the deployment observation

column3: checked-release seal, key-free and read-only, BEFORE any founding
column4: all five owned roles preflight equal:true against a fresh finalized observation; final_set_sha256 matches prepare --deployment-set-journal

column3: campaign --founding-only from plan-seal.json, --direct-fee-basis-points 50
column4: the Open Market's selected_release_set at offset 208 equals the SEALED plan's release set, read off chain and never pasted from prepare

column3: devnet-general-market then the ordinary founding campaign with market.json
column4: accelerator-observation.txt reports deployment_slot 491959038; the founding validator admits the General manifest

column3: devnet-direct-capability-activation-v1 --execute
column4: the report's verdict string is ACTIVATED, and the activation root derived in advance goes from AccountNotFound to a 256-byte DCLTCRT1 record

column3: devnet-general-capability-activation-v1 --execute
column4: the report carries schema dclutch-devnet-general-capability-activation-report-v1 and the root it named in advance is occupied

column3: devnet-sponsored-push-input-v1 twice (terminalSequence 0 and 1), then --action prepay-certificate --prepay-for settle
column4: the settle seat holds rent.minimum_balance(312) exactly, read back from chain

column3: fund two participants, then two user-position admissions and one collateral delegation
column4: the buyer's delegated account holds exactly required_buyer_collateral atoms

column3: the Direct session, nine transactions, gross 200 at 50 bps per side
column4: the Hot transaction commits under 1,400,000 CU and the measured figure is recorded beside cohort-13's 1,286,187

column3: devnet-direct-fee-settlement-v1, permissionless
column4: fee_owed reads 0 off chain after the transaction, which is the only thing that distinguishes a settled fee from a sent one

column3: ledger-census with the four declared flags and --declared-fees-lamports
column4: L1 through L8 each reported BY NAME; an INAPPLICABLE is not a pass

column3: OpenBatch N=2 against the activated General root
column4: the batch executes on chain; this needs cohort-14 specifically, because a517d27c's inline input transport is in Trading

column3: devnet-sponsored-relay-schedule-v1 --wait capture, then --action capture
column4: the capture commits and the candidate's snapshot_unix_seconds is inside [start, end], read off the candidate account

column3: the same schedule --wait settle, then --action settle
column4: Source state reaches Resolved rather than FailureCommitted, and the certificate kind is 1 and not 4

column3: devnet-sponsored-push-v1 --action admit-terminal
column4: the Market's phase byte goes 1 to 2 and terminal_receipt carries the certificate's own address

column3: wallet-terminal-payout-input then the payout, into the owner's own ATA
column4: the destination is 170 bytes before AND after, its ImmutableOwner suffix byte-identical, and the Hoard falls by exactly the atoms paid
